name: plasticity-mcp
description: Local Plasticity CAD and Workbench MCP tools for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Model in Plasticity and review results in Workbench.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to locally installed Plasticity CAD and Workbench for model review, dimensional feedback, and print preparation.
defaultPrompt: List my Plasticity windows and ask which one to use.
Review the current Plasticity model and measure it.
Prepare a model for printing without starting a print.
